    root = design.rootComponent

    print('Faces:', body.faces.count)
    # Categorize faces
    planar_z = {}
    cyls = []
    for f in body.faces:
        geo = f.geometry
        if isinstance(geo, adsk.core.Plane):
            n = geo.normal
            # detect horizontal planes (normal along Z)
            if abs(abs(n.z)-1.0) < 1e-3:
                z = round(f.pointOnFace.z*10,3)
                planar_z.setdefault(z, 0)
                planar_z[z]+=1

            bb=f.boundingBox
            cyls.append((round(geo.radius*10,3), round(bb.minPoint.z*10,2), round(bb.maxPoint.z*10,2)))
    print('Horizontal plane Z levels (mm): count')
    for z in sorted(planar_z):
        print('  z=',z,'faces=',planar_z[z])
    print('Cylindrical faces (radius mm, zmin, zmax):')
    for c in sorted(set(cyls)):
        print('  ', c)
